title: Make three slow functions fast
goal: Make the three functions in algos.py (lis_length, count_inversions, top_k_frequent) as fast as possible on large inputs while keeping their exact behavior, including edge cases and tie-breaking. The final algos.py is scored by hidden correctness tests and a hidden benchmark; any correctness failure scores zero. Use python3; bench.py and test_algos.py are there to help. Each worker should leave its best version in algos.py in its own workspace.
rubric: Correctness first, then speed. Prefer asymptotic improvements over micro-tuning. Verify against the original implementation on many random inputs, including negatives, duplicates and floats, before claiming a speedup.
